measurements.label: Reviewed facial height / width
measurements.definition: Mesh-top-to-chin vertical height / horizontal cheek span.

measurements.label: Reviewed facial width-to-height ratio
measurements.definition: Horizontal cheek span / medial-brow-to-upper-lip vertical distance.

measurements.label: Reviewed mesh upper segment share
measurements.definition: Mesh-top-to-medial-brow segment / sum of three vertical segments.

measurements.label: Reviewed middle segment share
measurements.definition: Medial-brow-to-nose-base segment / sum of three vertical segments.

measurements.label: Reviewed lower segment share
measurements.definition: Nose-base-to-chin segment / sum of three vertical segments.

measurements.label: Reviewed middle / lower segment
measurements.definition: Medial-brow-to-nose-base distance / nose-base-to-chin distance.

measurements.label: Reviewed forehead width / cheek width
measurements.definition: Horizontal mesh-forehead span / horizontal cheek span; not the hairline.

measurements.label: Reviewed jaw width / cheek width
measurements.definition: Horizontal visible lower-jaw landmark span / horizontal cheek span.

measurements.label: Reviewed chin width / jaw width
measurements.definition: Horizontal chin landmark span / horizontal lower-jaw span.

measurements.label: Reviewed eye spacing
measurements.definition: Horizontal inner-corner span / horizontal outer-corner span.

measurements.label: Reviewed eye opening height / width
measurements.definition: Mean vertical eye opening / mean horizontal eye width.

measurements.label: Reviewed canthal tilt
measurements.definition: Mean outer-corner elevation angle relative to inner corners; head roll affects it.

measurements.label: Reviewed brow elevation / face height
measurements.definition: Mean eye-centre-to-brow-peak vertical elevation / mesh-top-to-chin height.

measurements.label: Reviewed nose width / cheek width
measurements.definition: Horizontal nose-wing landmark span / horizontal cheek span.

measurements.label: Reviewed nose width / mouth width
measurements.definition: Horizontal nose-wing landmark span / horizontal mouth-corner span.

measurements.label: Reviewed mouth width / cheek width
measurements.definition: Horizontal mouth-corner span / horizontal cheek span.

measurements.label: Reviewed lip height / lower segment
measurements.definition: Visible upper-to-lower lip vertical height / nose-base-to-chin distance.

measurements.label: Reviewed philtrum / lower segment
measurements.definition: Nose-base-to-upper-lip vertical distance / nose-base-to-chin distance.

measurements.label: Hairline-to-chin height / cheek width
measurements.definition: Visible central hairline-to-chin vertical height / horizontal cheek span. Separate from mesh height.

measurements.label: Hairline upper segment share
measurements.definition: Hairline-to-medial-brow segment / sum of hairline, middle and lower vertical segments.

measurements.label: Hairline-defined middle segment share
measurements.definition: Medial-brow-to-nose-base segment / sum of hairline, middle and lower vertical segments.

measurements.label: Hairline-defined lower segment share
measurements.definition: Nose-base-to-chin segment / sum of hairline, middle and lower vertical segments.

frontal.note: Reviewed 2D photo measurements. No matching manual-reference percentiles or calibrated uncertainty. Head pose and placement affect readings. These measurements have no reference-bank percentiles and do not infer depth.

measurements.label: Soft-tissue profile angle
measurements.definition: Internal angle at the nose base between bridge and forward chin (N–Sn–Pog).

measurements.label: Profile angle including nose
measurements.definition: Internal angle at the nose tip between bridge and forward chin (N–Prn–Pog).

measurements.label: Upper-lip offset from nose–chin line
measurements.definition: Signed perpendicular distance from upper lip to tip–chin line, divided by bridge-to-bottom-chin distance. Positive is forward.

measurements.label: Lower-lip offset from nose–chin line
measurements.definition: Signed perpendicular distance from lower lip to tip–chin line, divided by bridge-to-bottom-chin distance. Positive is forward.

measurements.label: Custom nasal projection / face height
measurements.definition: Unsigned perpendicular distance from Prn to the infinite N–Sn line / Euclidean N–Me distance.

measurements.label: Nasal chord / face height
measurements.definition: Euclidean N–Prn distance / Euclidean N–Me distance; a photo-space chord, not physical nose length.

measurements.label: Lower-face chord / face height
measurements.definition: Euclidean Sn–Me distance / Euclidean N–Me distance, not a projected vertical-third measure.

measurements.label: Upper-minus-lower lip offset
measurements.definition: Upper minus lower signed offset from the same Prn–Pog line, using Euclidean N–Me normalization. Derived contrast, not independent evidence.

profile.note: Two-dimensional soft-tissue readings from user-placed landmarks on one lateral photograph. Placement, head posture and perspective affect them. No calibrated uncertainty or bone-position diagnosis. These do not change the frontal geometry score. Facing is user-declared in the displayed image. Opposite-side views are separate observations, not a calibrated asymmetry test. All reference lengths are Euclidean; none uses a vertical world axis.

composite.explanation: A design-weighted summary of measured geometry, not a population percentile or a validated attractiveness rating. Higher means more central proportions, less measured asymmetry and greater reference-shape typicality. These components overlap. Dimorphism is descriptive and does not change the total.
composite.uncertainty: Not calibrated; photo quality is separate from the score.

headline.explanation: A design-weighted summary of measured geometry, not a population percentile or a validated attractiveness rating. Higher means more central proportions, less measured asymmetry and greater reference-shape typicality. These components overlap. Dimorphism is descriptive and does not change the total.
headline.uncertainty: Not calibrated; photo quality is separate from the score.

score_audit.decision: Retain geometry-composite-v1. Independent development/held-out evidence does not yet justify a replacement.
score_audit.interpretation: Component centrality overlaps. Leave-out results describe formula sensitivity, not expected personal change. No photo-quality penalty or profile contribution is added.
